question: Within the unchanged original Reflection-v4 chronological118 system, what changes when the same pinned base runs with the existing trained private adapter disabled?
inference: This estimates the incremental effect of this adapter in this controller on four inspected development roots. It is not proof that language models beat strong equally informed numerical control, not full literal D-SE superiority, and not a replay of the historical paper's unknown base revision.

enabled_baseline_reuse.all4_completed_enabled_outcomes: Reuse exactly; no enabled generation, old physics or old readers rerun.
enabled_baseline_reuse.old_failed_fixed_gate: Preserved. The new disabled attribution arm cannot turn the original failed HG-VF-versus-DFF gate into a pass.
enabled_baseline_reuse.case0_original_supervisor_exit: UNKNOWN remains; independently closed evidence and actual preserved results retained.
enabled_baseline_reuse.historical_costs: All old setup/model/training/transport/physical/preparation/failure and independent verification costs retained, including unrecovered quantities as UNKNOWN.

minimal_ordered_execution.operation: Finish independent source/input review and saved-only engineering reader; bind existing isolated original loader/setup/host/transport and one actual profile/assignment under fixed ownership and bounds.
minimal_ordered_execution.current: Four exact causal requests/token IDs and remote source are prepared; nine pure boundary checks passed. No inference, tokenizer, native or allocation occurred.

minimal_ordered_execution.operation: One separately bounded engineering job: four fixed initial original118 requests with adapter disabled plus one explicitly charged fresh-model cold replica of case0's first request.
minimal_ordered_execution.acceptance: Identity, exact full tokens, every-forward disabled state, raw outcome preservation, immutable tensor values and exact cold sequence; never output validity, action quality or a favorable case.
minimal_ordered_execution.scope: Zero PF/controller/optimizer/training. One T4 suffices for this0.5B gate; no idle three-profile allocation. Actual eligibility/assignment must be checked only at admission, with no reset/lifetime guesses.

minimal_ordered_execution.operation: After actual engineering owner/collector/reader closure and preservation, freeze four complete new disabled original-policy episodes and partial-aware independent reader with the existing enabled endpoints reused.
minimal_ordered_execution.input_reuse: Each new engineering primary response is reused once at its exact disabled-mode/context identity. A cold replica is a verification cost, not another primary policy choice. Enabled replies cannot satisfy disabled requests.
minimal_ordered_execution.limits: Engineering success does not automatically admit this full campaign. All current relevant physical studies must close before taking a frozen input-history snapshot; integrate only genuinely new closed scopes, preserving failed/unclosed collisions.

minimal_ordered_execution.operation: Execute original function ASTs and original chronological proposal/reprompt/feedback/refinement/fallback/selection on all four fixed roots; source logical order must be identical to the original algorithm, while trajectories may diverge from adapter-enabled because outputs differ.
minimal_ordered_execution.unchanged: 25 iterations, four source zones, original Q grid/caps/no-refund, raw candidate scope, original1.06 native hard guard, strict0.95/1.05 reporting, source score and HG-SE selector. No prompt/output repair beyond the original conditional reprompt rule.
minimal_ordered_execution.physics: Reuse exact closed native input/options/kwargs returns with required preparation/extraction and original costs. Fresh physics only for prospectively admitted unexecuted identities after exact relevant history checks; failed/unknown collisions stop before a repeat.
minimal_ordered_execution.cold: Actual first committed disabled state must preserve original NET/result/feedback/failed histories/cap/cursor/RNG and paid model/physics ledgers. Reconstruct only from exact saved new-disabled and paid physical returns; no repeated scientific call or enabled-prefix substitution.

minimal_ordered_execution.operation: First independent physical replay only for new returned PF; source/complete chronological policy/cold/input/model-mode/full-cost review; all returned adverse results and incomplete identities retained.
minimal_ordered_execution.analysis: All-four closed paired UV/OV/full-band/deficit/actions/Q/tokens/elapsed/full-cost contrasts. Partial leaves aggregate four-root contrasts UNKNOWN. No selected best checkpoint, prompt, case or output.

same_controller_numerical_control.owner: Scientific peer is preparing a source-compatible replacement for the direct language proposal provider.
same_controller_numerical_control.required: Same original causal information, raw candidate scope, Q/cap restrictions and per-zone proposal/repair/query allowance; identical original downstream verifier/refinement/fallback/selection. Full source costs charged.
same_controller_numerical_control.not_sufficient: No-LLM DFF uses a different proposal/fallback search path. It remains valuable but alone does not isolate information/query budget from language contribution. A simple weakest-voltage rule cannot silently be called the strongest numeric control.
same_controller_numerical_control.existing_numeric_readouts: Prior75% numeric teacher readout is not automatically compatible with the exact chronological messages/history/action domain; source/input mapping must be verified before reuse.
same_controller_numerical_control.full_literal_DSE: DFF plus DFF-ALT plus unchanged numerical selector, both individual branches and FULL BOTH costs remain required for the broad G5 superiority claim. Paper HG-SE is a different DFF-plus-HG-VF selector.

metrics_and_predeclaration.primary: All four paired strict UV and strict OV counts and joint full118-band restoration; retain the original23October descriptive metric definitions. Report every win/tie/loss.
metrics_and_predeclaration.secondary: Deficit/Vmin/Vmax, installed Q/original operations, valid/null/reprompt/unsafe proposal counts, actual model/PF/cold/replay/preparation/failure and complete branch costs.
metrics_and_predeclaration.sensitivity: Any common1e-8 reporting allowance is an explicitly separate identical-all-arms sensitivity; it cannot change native guard, reward, classification or primary failure labels.
metrics_and_predeclaration.no_new_success_threshold: The full attribution hypothesis/gate must be frozen before new disabled outputs. No engineering-response-based threshold selection or manufactured causal significance from four related development worlds.
metrics_and_predeclaration.confirmation: None of the four roots is unused; success can justify a separately prospective confirmation, not G5.3 completion.
